description: This file implements the MerchantStoreDao interface, providing data access methods for MerchantStore entities, including fetching products for a merchant store, retrieving stores by ID or code, and using Hibernate and QueryDSL for database operations.

classes.name: MerchantStoreDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of MerchantStoreDao providing data access operations for MerchantStore entities, utilizing Hibernate and QueryDSL.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of Product entities associated with a given MerchantStore, constructing a complex HQL query with multiple joins and fetches.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a MerchantStore entity by its ID using QueryDSL and JPQL.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Retrieves a MerchantStore entity either by code or by merchant store ID, using QueryDSL and JPQL.
